Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the mention of the cemetery, add a small visual detail to make the setting clearer, such as “墓地里有人低着头祭拜，四周安安静静的。”
2. At “去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿,” add Mengzi’s reaction to show why he is interested in going there, such as “孟子觉得那里的人做的事很有趣。”
3. Add a short line of dialogue between Mengzi and his friends to make the scene livelier, such as “孟子对朋友们说：‘我们也来学他们祭拜吧！’”

ideas.reason: The visual detail fits a cemetery and helps make the setting clearer.
It gives a simple, story-appropriate reason that Mengzi wants to go there.
The dialogue fits the tale because Mengzi imitates the people performing funeral rites.
